expression:
local({
  t2 <- c(0, NA, NA, 0.125, 0.375, 0.75, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4)
  t3 <- c(0, 0.125, 0.375, 0.75, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4)
  together <- if_else(
    wave == "T2",
    t2[PC_BabyTV + 1] + t2[PC_OtherTV + 1] + t2[PC_BabyGames + 1],
    t3[PC_Time_BabyTV + 1] *
      PC_Days_BabyTV /
      7 +
      t3[PC_Time_OtherTV + 1] * PC_Days_OtherTV / 7 +
      t3[PC_Time_BabyGames + 1] * PC_Days_BabyGames / 7
  )
  alone <- if_else(
    wave == "T2",
    t2[CA_BabyTV + 1] + t2[CA_OtherTV + 1] + t2[CA_BabyGames + 1],
    t3[CA_Time_BabyTV + 1] *
      CA_Days_BabyTV /
      7 +
      t3[as.numeric(na_if(CA_Time_OtherTV, "missing_error")) + 1] * CA_Days_OtherTV / 7 +
      t3[CA_Time_BabyGames + 1] * CA_Days_BabyGames / 7
  )
  share <- together / (together + alone)
  case_when(
    is.na(together) | is.na(alone) ~ NA_character_,
    together == 0 ~ "Never",
    share <= 0.10 ~ "Rarely",
    share <= 0.35 ~ "Sometimes",
    share <= 0.70 ~ "Often",
    .default = "Always"
  )
})
notes: Share of screen hours spent with a parent, parent or carer report over baby TV, older-viewer TV and baby games: PC_ (TOGETHER with your child) / (PC_ + CA_ (ALONE)), hours as on st_watch and st_game; video calls left out (no alone item). Cuts: 0 Never, up to 0.10 Rarely, up to 0.35 Sometimes, up to 0.70 Often, above 0.70 Always; no TV or games use = Never. T2 recall the Spring 2020 lockdown, as on st_watch; 'most days': NA where any term is code 1 or 2 (a frequency with no duration). T3 recall 'during the November lockdown period', with 'missing_error' NA. Partial: hours with a parent beside hours alone.
